messages.content: 你能幫我找到加州洛杉磯的素食餐廳嗎？它們至少要營業到晚上10點，然後也幫我找一下加州舊金山和華盛頓州西雅圖的素食餐廳嗎？

function.name: vegan_restaurant_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby vegan restaurants based on specific criteria like operating hours. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. New York, NY

operating_hours.description: Preferred latest closing time of the restaurant. E.g. if 11 is given, then restaurants that close at or after 11 PM will be considered. This is in 24 hour format.

message.reasoning: The user wants vegan restaurants in Los Angeles, California, that close at or after 10 PM (i.e., 22). Also wants vegan restaurants in San Francisco, CA, and Seattle, WA. They didn't specify operating hours for SF and Seattle, but likely want similar criteria? The user said "它們至少要營業到晚上10點" which refers to the restaurants. That might apply to all three cities. So we need to find vegan restaurants in LA, SF, Seattle that close at or after 10 PM. We have a function vegan_restaurant_find_nearby that takes location and operating_hours. The default operating_hours is 21. We need to set operating_hours to 22. So we call the function for each location: "Los Angeles, CA", "San Francisco, CA", "Seattle, WA". The function returns any. We need to call it three times. The function signature: vegan_restaurant_find_nearby({location: string, operating_hours?: number}). So we call with location: "Los Angeles, CA", operating_hours: 22. Then same for "San Francisco, CA" and "Seattle, WA". We'll produce three calls. The function returns any. We'll output the results.
